thread:
emma: Heads-up — packaging staging signer is backing up (~45m). cosign worker on pack-host-02 is thrashing with transient KMS errors. Holding RC3 packaging for private/VPC onprem until we confirm artifacts are fully signed. Please do NOT promote any images or publish airgap bundles.

packaging-bot: ALERT: signer-delay=2700s blocked_artifacts=12 host=pack-host-02 suggestion=hold-promotion :warning:

noah: Ack. Pausing the 11:30PT canary. I'll stop the release window and update the notes.

ravi: deploy-bot: pausing promos for project=private-vpc target=rc3 reason="signer-lag"
Command run: `deploy-bot pause --project private-vpc --tag rc3 --reason "signer-lag"` :white_check_mark:

olivia: Suggest we pin the staging manifest to last-known-good to avoid partial manifests hitting airgap customers. Running a shrinkwrap pin now: `shrinkwrap manifest pin --manifest staging-manifest.json --tag rc3-pin-20260320`

emma: I'll open a hotfix to rotate the cosign agent and bump timeouts. PR #1244 opened (packaging/cosign-timeout). ETA ~25m to deploy the agent restart.

noah: For rollback criteria: if signer not recovered within 2 hours, we should abort RC3 and revert to rc2 manifest. Proposed rule: immediate rollback to `rc2-stable` tag if signer_down_duration > 7200s. Thoughts?

emma: +1 to rollback rule. Also adding a temporary tag-guardrail: prevent any `latest` or promoted tags pointing at unsigned digests. Guardrail cmd: `packaging-bot set-guardrail --prevent-unsigned=true --scope project=private-vpc`

ravi: Added canary-only hold too: `deploy-bot hold --scope canary --reason "signer-lag"` so full prod promos are explicitly gated (no silent promos).

packaging-bot: LOG SNIPPET:
```
2026-03-20T18:07:12Z pack-host-02 cosign[1234]: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = kms: key not found
2026-03-20T18:07:13Z pack-host-02 cosign[1234]: retrying (1/5)
2026-03-20T18:12:30Z pack-host-02 cosign[1234]: signed artifact: /tmp/rc3/artifact-42.tar.gz sha256=abcdef...
```

olivia: Once cosign is healthy we'll need to: 1) re-run full packaging (`packaging-bot publish --airgap --manifest rc3-pin-20260320`), 2) push checksums to s3 (`s3://private-vpc-artifacts/rc3/sha256.txt`), 3) update release-notes with the delay and that there were no functional changes.

noah: I'll update the release-notes now: short bullet "Packaging delay due to signer rotation; no code changes; canary postponed." Also noting rollback path -> rc2-stable if unresolved after 2h.

emma: Quick ops note: if KMS key is flapping, we may need to failover to alternate key in KMS project. I've requested infra to standby for key failover.

packaging-bot: signer recovered at 2026-03-20T18:43:01Z host=pack-host-02. blocked_artifacts=0. Releasing promotion hold in 5m once packaging sanity checks pass.

ravi: Received recovery. Will resume promos after Emma confirms re-publish and checksum push.

olivia: After publish, I'll run an airgap preflight on a staging mirror and confirm installer checksums before we unhold the production window.

emma: Confirmed republish started. ETA 12m. Keeping rollback plan in place until we verify mirror checksums.

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> released by deploy-bot after manual resume. Run `deploy-bot resume --project private-vpc --tag rc3` to continue. :rocket:
